operational_breakthrough_DGEBA_amine_mar.geometry: one exposed face, impermeable steel substrate (effective 2*DFT)
operational_breakthrough_DGEBA_amine_mar.note: REFERENCE_NOMINAL geometry/D: DFT and D flagged, set TIMESCALE only.
operational_breakthrough_DGEBA_amine_mar.operational_finding: At a real 250 um marine DFT with the literature DGEBA-amine D, water half-saturates the film to the steel in ~hours and 90%-saturates in well under a day. Water ARRIVAL at steel is fast; marine barrier protection is therefore a STEADY-STATE-PERMEANCE (P=D*S) and WET-ADHESION problem, not a water-arrival-delay problem. This inverts the naive 'thicker=slower water' intuition and is the actionable takeaway.

permeance_ranking_3_real_systems.D_treatment: shared literature anchor; validated FFV free-volume ordering (CYDM tightest < DDS < 8CH2DA loosest) reinforces same direction
permeance_ranking_3_real_systems.figure_of_merit: P = D * S  (lower = better barrier); S ~ equilibrium M_inf
permeance_ranking_3_real_systems.resolves_prior_ambiguity: barrier-water-uptake-hydrophilicity-ccby-v1 found hydrophilic-group density anti-correlated with uptake within this family (underdetermined, rho=-0.5). The permeance composition P=D*S is UNAMBIGUOUS here: EP-CYDM wins on BOTH low uptake (S) and tight free volume (D); EP-8CH2DA loses on both. The two independent barrier descriptors agree once combined.

fitted_parameters: NONE (all closed-form identities; D/DFT are flagged constants)
honest_limitations: Absolute D is REFERENCE_NOMINAL: the literature DGEBA-amine band spans 1e-13..2e-11 m2/s across protocols/temperature (2+ orders); only the within-family RANKING (real M_inf, reinforced by validated FFV) is defended.
Real epoxies often show PSEUDO-FICKIAN / two-stage sorption; single-D Fickian is an engineering approximation (flagged, documented in the source literature).
D is strongly Arrhenius in temperature; the marine service T is not fixed here.

n=3 systems, single immersion protocol -> not statistically promotable; same data wall as barrier-water-uptake. Precise per-system validation needs time-resolved gravimetric curves for >=~10 protocol-matched DGEBA-amine films.

new_axis_justification: All 66 signed receipts treat the barrier at EQUILIBRIUM (water-uptake, tortuosity, thermal-CTE) or via a STATIC free-volume proxy for D (barrier-freevolume-ffv-v1). None computes the TIME for water/O2 to traverse a real dry-film-thickness, nor the steady-state permeance P=D*S that governs the wet coating. This is the transient-kinetics gap.
non_circularity: Known-answer identities are pure mathematics (Crank series), independent of any coating data. The real anchors (D, M_inf) are measured externally under CC-BY licenses and are NOT used to fit the identities -- KA4 round-trips the anchor D through the independent series and recovers it. The 3-system ranking uses real in-tree M_inf; D magnitude is a flagged shared constant.
